notes.subject: חֵפֶשׂ
notes.rationale: occurs only here in the Tanakh; root חפשׂ 'to search', so a scheme searched-out — the participle מחופש echoes the same root.

notes.subject: חֵפֶשׂ מְחֻפָּשׂ
notes.rationale: noun and passive participle of the same root piled together; English 'searched-out scheme, searched-out' carries the doubling.

notes.subject: is
notes.rationale: Hebrew lacks a copula between 'heart' and 'deep'.

notes.subject: וקרב איש ולב עמק
notes.rationale: either the plotters' boast that man's inward mind is unfathomable, or the narrator's aside that the human heart is deep.

translation: They search out injustices; “We have completed a searched-out scheme, and the inward part of a man and a heart ⟨is⟩ deep.”
